title: Sliding window counter rate limiter
summary: Approximate a true sliding window from two fixed-window counters, weighting the previous window by how much of it still overlaps.

complexity.space: O(1): two counters and a window start

hints: A sliding log is exact but stores every timestamp. You only need two numbers: how many requests the previous aligned window allowed and how many the current one has so far.

The window containing t starts at floor(t / window) × window. When t lands in the next window, the current count becomes the previous one; when it skips a whole window or more, the previous count is 0.
estimate = prev × (1 − (t − start) / window) + curr. Refuse if estimate ≥ limit without counting; otherwise curr += 1. Check t against the last timestamp before you roll anything.
